no-restricted-syntax.message: Use semantic color tokens instead of hardcoded background colors. Replace with bg-card, bg-surface, bg-success, bg-warning, bg-destructive, or bg-info.
Use semantic color tokens instead of hardcoded text colors. Replace with text-text-primary, text-text-muted, text-success, text-warning, text-destructive, or text-info.
Use semantic color tokens instead of hardcoded border colors. Replace with border-border, border-success, border-warning, border-destructive, or border-info.
Use semantic color tokens instead of hardcoded dark mode backgrounds. Replace with bg-card, bg-surface, or other semantic tokens.
Use semantic color tokens instead of hardcoded dark mode text colors. Replace with text-text-primary, text-text-muted, or other semantic tokens.
Use semantic color tokens instead of hardcoded dark mode borders. Replace with border-border or other semantic tokens.
